summary: End-to-end testing of R2 Construction MVP. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed for /api/estimates CRUD + stats + validation. Frontend: Hero, CTAs, 6 services, portfolio filters, estimate form (validation + valid submission), and Admin page (list, summary, view dialog, status change, refresh, delete with confirm) all working. Full integration: UI submission appeared in admin and was deletable.
critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering: /api/estimates/stats/summary works because FastAPI matches /estimates/{id} too — currently it returns 404 (path 'stats' treated as id then no doc) only if order changes. Current order in server.py has /estimates/{id} declared BEFORE /estimates/stats/summary. This works because 'stats' is a valid string for {estimate_id} and returns 404 for that lookup — but /stats/summary is matched explicitly because the GET path /estimates/stats/summary has 2 path segments after /estimates which {estimate_id} cannot capture. Verified passing in tests, but consider moving stats route above /{estimate_id} for clarity.
EstimateRequest model uses datetime which is serialized to ISO; manual conversion in routes is repetitive — could be centralized.
No pagination on GET /estimates (hardcoded 1000 list limit) — fine for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed TEST_ created and cleaned up via tests and UI delete
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_estimates.py — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_estimates.py -v. Admin route is /admin (no auth).
